text.p: Butler International Inc said Thursday demand for its services remains strong and it expects "significant earnings increases in 1997."
On Thursday the company reported a jump in earnings to $0.22 per share $0.01 in the year-ago quarter.

We expect the earnings trend to continue into the fourth quarter, most notably in our targeted growth areas of Technology Solutions, Telecommunications Services and Fleet Services," the company stated. "We remain dedicated to growing our higher margin businesses, while aggressively controlling expenses and improving productivity. As a result, we expect significant earnings increases in 1997 generated by moderate sales growth."
